残っていたのは、彼女の残り香と、
俺の背中に刻まれた、何本もの爪痕と、
シーツに染み付いていた、初めての証。
lines.english: All she left behind was her lingering scent, the tracks of her nails scored across my back, and the proof of our first time stained into the sheets.

lines.japanese: そして、なくなったものは…
lines.english: And what had disappeared…

lines.japanese: 俺の制服から引きちぎられていた、ボタン二つ。
lines.english: were two buttons torn from my school uniform.
